public_log.text: Company founded with about $153 in starting capital, run with Claude by Anthropic via Claude Code (about $26/month).
Name chosen: TaktWork. "Takt" is the lean term for the steady pace work should flow at, and "work" echoes "clockwork".
Plan v2: global from day 1, a Danish-market product parked.
Sent the owner's email address as contact info to a public lookup service. New rule: neutral sender only.
First plan compared too few options. New rule: always compare at least 3 directions in a table.
